title: Introduce granular SLO-weighted eviction and connection fairness orchestrator
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Adds a configurable SLO-weighted eviction policy and connection fairness layer to reduce tenant-induced oscillation under surge. No customer-facing API changes. Rollout as a staged canary with telemetry gated rollback.
description: Summary: Implements a runtime-level orchestrator that combines per-tenant SLO weights, recent token/connection usage heuristics, and circuit breaker state to decide eviction pressure and fair connection allocation. Motivation: Recent incidents showed that aggressive single-tenant bursts could destabilize local KV caches and connection pools, causing cascading slowpaths in regional failovers. Rather than coarse tenant de-prioritization we need a finer-grained policy that: 1) honors explicit SLO weightings (e.g., premium vs free), 2) smooths transient spikes using an exponential decay window, and 3) coordinates with circuit-breaker health so we avoid pushing degraded tenants into immediate hard eviction. What this PR does: - New orchestration module: runtime/evictor/slo_orchestrator.go that computes a tenant priority score combining SLO weight, recent tokens/sec, connection-hold time, and current circuit state. - Connection fairness: runtime/conn_pool/fair_allocator.go adds soft quotas and a reclaim path that respects per-tenant score. - Eviction soft-exit: runtime/evictor/decay_controller.go implements a configurable decay window and prevents immediate re-open flips by recording ephemeral penalty snapshots. - Telemetry: observability/metrics/evictor.metrics.yaml and docs/telemetry/README.md describing the new counters and dashboards. - Config: ops/configs/evictor_profiles.yaml contains profiles and sane defaults; ops/airbyte/rollout-plan.md has the staged rollout. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed (ENG-2149) - [x] Unit+integration tests for fairness allocator - [x] CI green on canary cluster run - [x] Dashboard and alert updates included - [x] Rollout plan with abort criteria included Commits summary: - Initial implementation of slo_orchestrator with scoring function and tests - Add fair_allocator and integrate with conn pool lifecycle - Implement decay_controller and penalty snapshot storage - Telemetry and dashboard wiring - Rollout plan and config profiles - Hotfix: prevent rapid penalty re-apply on reconnect race (follow-up commit) Files changed (high level): - runtime/evictor/slo_orchestrator.go - runtime/conn_pool/fair_allocator.go - runtime/evictor/decay_controller.go - observability/metrics/evictor.metrics.yaml - ops/configs/evictor_profiles.yaml - docs/telemetry/README.md - ops/airbyte/rollout-plan.md Testing notes: unit tests included for scoring boundaries and allocator fairness; integration test simulates multi-tenant burst to validate no single tenant drives more than 65% of connection slots when below a threshold score. Load test on canary (region us-east-1) shows 18% reduction in cascade slowpaths and elimination of repeated circuit flips during replayed incidents. Diego: "Telemetry names LGTM; add a short-lived alert to detect unexpected evictor rejections." Merge notes: merged to main via squash merge after +2 approvals and canary run. Post-merge actions: - Kick off staged rollout (ops/airbyte/rollout-plan.md) to 10% -> 50% -> 100% over 48h windows - Monitor evictor.rejection_rate and slo-weighted-fairness breach metrics for first 72h - Prepare rollback branch feature/evictor-rollback if we observe >0.5% customer error-rise within 30m of each ramp. Related: ENG-2170 (follow-up: expose per-tenant debug dump for on-call), ENG-2149 (design). Notes: No public API or migration required. This PR is intended to be non-breaking and reversible; configs default to conservative profiles to avoid surprises.
